rows.name: protected_copper_preserved
rows.why: all 235 segment(s) on ANT_FEED, NFC1, NFC2 came back, each within 55 nm of where it was sent — under the 100 nm the format can carry (halo_rev_a.filtered.ses: (resolution um 10) = one step is 0.0001 mm). 10 segment(s) ADDED on those nets ({'ANT_FEED': 5, 'NFC1': 5}) — the router extending a protected net to reach its pads, which is routing, not rerouting

rows.name: antenna_arm_not_shadowed
rows.why: COPPER IS SHADOWING THE 2.4 GHz ARM at -0.1747 mm, under the 0.3 mm floor: net NFC1 on B.Cu at (22.577, 8.13). The board's own keep-out forbids pours and vias in the antenna sector and ALLOWS TRACKS, so a router walks straight through it. lane T3, 2026-09-05: the Ø25.2 mm coil at a 0.30 mm gap solves to 2.4321 GHz in band; the same coil under the arm solves to 1.7666 GHz, a 668 MHz shift that is not recoverable by tuning. Closest per net: NFC1 -0.1747, NFC2 -0.0901, XL1 +0.2630, PIEZO_DRV +0.3429, GND +0.4929
